answer: Problem: sybil farms spin disposable agents that mirror honest patterns just long enough to grab seats. Mechanism: each join posts a zephyr bond of 0.28 POA locked 36h and a yarrow work-index = sealed_peer_atts/(opens+2) recomputed every 3h; admit only if index≥0.14 and nullifier H(addr||epoch||bond_txid) is unique. Cost: clones lose the bond on nullifier clash and skip two redraws. Verification: panel recomputes index from sealed attests before sortition.
